stories.title: Reddit previews AI moderation tools and hints at changes to old.reddit.com
stories.summary: Reddit is rolling out AI-assisted moderation tools designed to make "karma" scores less of a gatekeeper for first-time posters, according to TechCrunch and The Verge. Separately, Ars Technica reports Reddit has signaled unspecified upcoming changes to the legacy old.reddit.com interface, without detailing what those changes will be.
stories.whyItMatters: Moderation and interface changes touch one of the web's largest community platforms and could reshape how new users are treated and how longtime power-users access the site.
